item.createpneumatictools.hand_drill.too: A _Mechanical Drill_ you can carry. Chews through anything a _pickaxe_ or a _shovel_ handles, on air rather than on durability.
Mines quickly, spending _one air_ per block. A full _Copper Backtank_ is 900 blocks.
Still mines, and still drops what a diamond tool would — just no faster than your bare hands.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_jack: A high-pressure _breaker_ for one block at a time. Shatters _hard_ blocks in a moment and does nothing for soft ones.
On Obsidian, Deepslate and the like
Breaks in _a quarter second_ whatever the hardness, for _ten air_ a block. Netherite tier.
On stone, dirt and other soft blocks
Slow, and free. The air is what does the shattering, so there is nothing to charge for.
item.createpneumatictools.tunnel_drill.t: Eight _Mechanical Drills_ around a wrench. Clears a _3x3 slice_ of the wall in front of you in one burst.
The eight around it go too, in the plane you are _looking along_. Charged _once_ for the burst.
Slower per block and dearer per block, and it moves nine times as much rock.
A _Mechanical Saw_ in your hand. Cut one log and the _whole tree_ comes down.
Fells the trunk and the canopy together, for _fifteen air_ — one payment per tree, not per log.
On bamboo, cane, cactus and chorus
Harvests the whole stalk, exactly as a mounted Mechanical Saw does.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_grin: A coarse abrasive wheel. Takes _one layer_ off whatever you hold it against.
_Strips_ bark from a log, _scrapes_ one stage of oxide off copper, or takes the _wax_ off a sealed block.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_buff: A soft pad spun fast enough that the finish it leaves is a _seal_. The Grinder's opposite number.
_Waxes_ it by friction alone. No _Honeycomb_ needed.
Right-Click the air, holding Rose Quartz
Polishes the _whole stack_ in your other hand at once, for three air apiece.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_vacu: Continuous suction. _Hold_ Right-Click and loose items and experience come to you.
Drags everything within _eight blocks_ to your feet, for one air every few ticks.
Costs nothing, so leaning on the button does not quietly empty the tank.
item.createpneumatictools.pneumatic_wren: Portable torque. Hold it against a shaft and it drives the network for as long as you hold the button.
Hold Right-Click on a shaft or cogwheel
Turns it at _32 RPM_ with _256 Stress Units_ behind it, the same as a _Hand Crank_ — and no hunger.
When you let go, walk away, or run dry
It stops. Nothing is left behind.
